name: Leadrat Real Estate CRM
description: Leadrat is a cloud-based real estate lead management platform used by property developers and brokers across India and the UAE. This connector gives Claude secure access to your Leadrat CRM — search and retrieve leads, update contact details, assign leads to agents, change pipeline statuses, add notes, and manage flags. Whether you're reviewing your daily pipeline, updating a lead after a site visit, or querying contacts by status, Leadrat's MCP connector lets you act on your CRM data without leaving your conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Leadrat Real Estate CRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Leadrat Real Estate CRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.leadrat.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Leadrat Real Estate CRM MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Leadrat Real Estate CRM provides these MCP tools: assign_lead, create_lead, get_lead, get_lead_flags, get_lead_statuses, search_leads, update_lead, update_lead_flag, update_lead_notes, and update_lead_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Leadrat Real Estate CRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Leadrat Real Estate CRM in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Leadrat Real Estate CRM MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Leadrat Real Estate CRM requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Leadrat Real Estate CRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: Leadrat Real Estate CRM is developed by Leadrat. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
